weather_report:
The quiet of the night embraces Boston, with the city lights twinkling like stars fallen to the earth, a clear invitation for moonlit wanderings. As we stand on the cusp of a new day, expect crisp air with temperatures dipping to around 44, stirred by a gentle northeast wind that whispers through the trees, perhaps a little too playful for late-night strollers. Anyone venturing out might find a light jacket or sweater a fitting companion, as the chill clings to the skin, hinting at the warmth that will soon emerge from the dawn.

As the sun rises, the day will unfold under a mostly cloudy sky. While no fog envelops the horizon, the clouds will cast a muted light over the city, creating an atmosphere that calls for cozy indoor pursuits. The chilly high of 52 invites layered clothing—perhaps a stylish scarf wrapped snugly, complementing a fortified cup of coffee or tea enjoyed at a favorite café. On such a day, a stroll along the harbor could be invigorating, though the weather steers one towards nurturing indoor activities, such as perusing a local bookstore or immersing oneself in the hushed ambiance of a museum. With the wind rustling above, let the day replenish your spirit, comfort in its cool embrace.
